title: Water Damage Mitigation Drying Plan Standard: Air Mover Placement by Water Class
content:
In a Water Damage Mitigation drying plan, air mover placement follows the IICRC class of the intrusion; the count fixed here is the number of air movers the drying estimate prices.

## Standard
Air mover placement follows the IICRC class: on a Class 3 job the air movers are one for every 60 square feet of the affected floor area, plus one for every 14 linear feet of the baseboard run on the job's baseboard removal lines, plus one for every 125 square feet of ceiling taken as the affected floor area, each of the three terms rounded up on its own; on a Class 2 job they are the floor term plus the wall term, each rounded up on its own; on any other job no class-based placement applies.

| IICRC class on the job record | Air movers |
|---|---|
| Class 3 | floor term (one per 60 sq ft) plus wall term (one per 14 lf of baseboard run) plus ceiling term (one per 125 sq ft), each rounded up on its own |
| Class 2 | floor term plus wall term, each rounded up on its own |
| Class 1 or Class 4 | no class-based placement |

## Worked figures (hypothetical: affected floor area 650 square feet, baseboard run 100 linear feet)
- Floor term: 650 divided by 60 is 10.83, rounded up to 11.
- Wall term: 100 divided by 14 is 7.14, rounded up to 8.
- Ceiling term: 650 divided by 125 is 5.2, rounded up to 6.
- Class 3 job: 25 air movers. Class 2 job: 19 air movers.
